what: Byte copies of the current-C workspace shell capture (the original shell documents and the captured Tool surfaces) read by the shell controls in tests/workspace_page/current_shell.rs. They replace the shell folder of the old app's mcp-apps-current-browser-20261026-c capture; the test pins capture.json by BLAKE3 and the capture pins the other files.
source_repository: trillion (the old app, sibling of this repository); commit 5c340ea748
not_included: The built asset tree of this capture (about 65 MB) and of the later d, e and f5 captures. The four controls that open those trees (actual_current_c_asset_module_and_mcp_resource_consumers_accept_the_same_cohort and the d, e and f5 cohort tests) still need OLD_APP_ROOT.
